review_basis: Real Pexels video frames at 15%, 50%, 85% from actual verified MP4s; editorial judgment based only on those twelve samples, not the entire video

decisions.rationale: Rainy street shows everyday traffic and pedestrians, but social-injustice passage is not meaningfully represented; distant signages and scene do not establish the intended Brazilian narrative. Avoid stock filler.
Dim warm-amber corridor visually matches tension and atmosphere; not evidence of historical biblical architecture. Conditional on careful context, safe-zone, logo and source-rights review.
Front close-up exposes face and eyeglasses of a different actor; contradicts anonymous recurring protagonist and original hands-only prayer concept. Third-party depiction needs separate checking.
Bright office/laptop and visible person mismatch dark modest-room journal aesthetic; writing may be readable and frames resemble generic corporate stock.
